business_summary: HDC Hyundai Engineering Plastics Co., Ltd. develops, produces, and supplies various plastic materials in South Korea and internationally. It offers polypropylene (PP) compound materials for use in producing automotive, interior/exterior materials, electrical and electronics components, water purifiers, etc. The company also provides thermoplastic elastomers; cross linkable polyethylene products, such as graftmers and catalyst M/B products; matt compounds consisting of BOPP, IPP, blown films, and blow molding compounds; PE, PP, and EVA based adhesive resins; pipe coating resins; and nylon and EVOH based barrier resins. In addition, it offers engineering plastics comprising nylon compounds, PET and PBT compounds, PBT/PET alloys, PC/ABS and PC/PBT alloys, PPE/PA and PPE/PS alloys, and PPS compounds; general purpose and high impact polystyrene products, which are used in various areas household goods and electrical appliances; and expandable polystyrene products that are used for shock absorption or packing materials. Further, the company provides construction materials, including polybutylene and polyethylene for raised temperature pipes; pipe connectors, including PB, brass, and water tap connectors; chlorinated polyvinyl chloride pipes and joints; household ventilation flat duct system; and integrated drainage systems. Additionally, it distributes products for use in cold and hot water supply, and heating applications. The company was formerly known as Hyundai Engineering Plastics Co., Ltd. HDC Hyundai Engineering Plastics Co., Ltd. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Dangjin-Si, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: HDC현대엔지니어링플라스틱(주)는 국내외 다양한 플라스틱 소재를 개발, 생산, 공급하고 있습니다. 자동차, 내외장재, 전기전자부품, 정수기 등에 사용되는 폴리프로필렌(PP) 복합소재를 제공하고 있다. 그래프트머 및 촉매 M/B 제품과 같은 가교결합성 폴리에틸렌 제품; BOPP, IPP, 블로운 필름, 블로우 몰딩 컴파운드로 구성된 무광택 컴파운드; PE, PP, EVA 계열의 접착수지; 파이프 코팅 수지; 나일론 및 EVOH 기반의 차단성 수지 등이 있습니다. 또한 나일론 컴파운드, PET 및 PBT 컴파운드, PBT/PET 합금, PC/ABS 및 PC/PBT 합금, PPE/PA 및 PPE/PS 합금, PPS 컴파운드로 구성된 엔지니어링 플라스틱을 제공합니다. 다양한 분야의 생활용품, 전기제품에 사용되는 일반 및 고충격 폴리스티렌 제품; 충격흡수용이나 포장재용으로 사용되는 발포폴리스티렌 제품 등이 있습니다. 또한 회사는 고온 파이프용 폴리부틸렌 및 폴리에틸렌을 포함한 건축 자재를 제공합니다.
